queries.name: txn_summary
queries.nrql: SELECT count(*) AS 'n', average(duration)*1000 AS 'avg_ms', percentile(duration,95)*1000 AS 'p95_ms', max(duration)*1000 AS 'max_ms' FROM Transaction {{appFilter}} SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

queries.name: discover_appnames
queries.nrql: SELECT uniques(appName) FROM Transaction SINCE 60 minutes ago LIMIT 50

queries.name: throughput
queries.nrql: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'req_per_min' FROM Transaction {{appFilter}} SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

queries.name: latency_p95
queries.nrql: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) * 1000 AS 'p95_ms' FROM Transaction {{appFilter}} SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

queries.name: top_transactions_p95
queries.nrql: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) * 1000 AS 'p95_ms' FROM Transaction {{appFilter}} FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

queries.name: error_count
queries.nrql: FROM TransactionError SELECT count(*) AS 'errors' SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

queries.name: top_errors
queries.nrql: FROM TransactionError SELECT count(*) AS 'count' FACET error.message LIMIT 10 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

queries.name: top_error_classes
queries.nrql: FROM TransactionError SELECT count(*) AS 'count' FACET error.class LIMIT 10 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago
